subject.title: fix(auth): decouple plugin synthetic-auth from profile fallback for gateway attempts (#110103)

question: Should `providerHasPluginSyntheticAuthHook` become a supported Plugin SDK export, or should core keep the gateway predicate behind an internal runtime-auth seam?
rationale: The generated Plugin SDK baseline shows this core helper would become an external compatibility contract, and the correct permanent API boundary is a maintainer product and ownership decision.

options.title: Use an internal core seam
options.body: Keep the gateway predicate out of the public Plugin SDK surface and adapt the core auth/runtime boundary to supply the needed prepared metadata.

options.title: Approve the SDK export
options.body: Accept the helper as a documented supported Plugin SDK API and add contract-level compatibility coverage and rationale.

recommendation.title: Use an internal core seam
recommendation.body: Keep the gateway predicate out of the public Plugin SDK surface and adapt the core auth/runtime boundary to supply the needed prepared metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be attributed safely from the available history evidence.
